illustration.description: Flat cartoon illustration with bold dark outlines and light grain texture, of a frustrated young man with short dark tousled hair and tan skin, furrowed brows and a pouting frown, wearing a pale mint-green hoodie with drawstrings. Both hands grip the top edges of the hoodie at the shoulders/collar, tugging it as if adjusting it. Small orange wavy motion lines flank both shoulders to suggest jittery fidgeting. Soft pastel palette of mint green, tan, and charcoal with an off-white background, no ground shadow, clean centered composition.

graphics.description: Two pairs of small orange wavy squiggle motion lines, one pair on each side of the figure's shoulders indicating shaking or fidgeting
Mirrored pair of orange wavy squiggle motion lines on the right side of the figure's shoulders
